say:2:1223215001:0.text: We can't keep going like this...
say:2:1223215001:0.male: We can't keep going like this...
say:2:1223215001:0.female: We can't keep going like this...

say:3:1223215002:0.text: Cecil, you all go and rest. I'm having a chat with <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:3:1223215002:0.male: Cecil, you all go and rest. I'm having a chat with <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:3:1223215002:0.female: Cecil, you all go and rest. I'm having a chat with <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:4:1223215003:0.text: Rest? How can we rest when our roof's been leaking for months? When will we have the money to fix it?
say:4:1223215003:0.source_cn: 休息？哪还顾得上休息，屋顶都漏水好几个月了，什么时候有...

say:5:1223215004:0.text: It's definitely on our to-do list, but we're in the red again today.
say:5:1223215004:0.source_cn: 不是不修，只是今天的进账，又是负的。

say:6:1223215005:0.text: If we're going to lose money every day, we might as well just give up now and find a hole to die in.
say:6:1223215005:0.source_cn: 啊？要我说，照这样天天负进账，不如直接一步到位，大家啥...

say:7:1223215006:0.text: I heard a typhoon is coming soon. Let's just let it bring us to the great beyond.
say:7:1223215006:0.source_cn: 正好，马上台风要来了，等台风一来，大家一起上天！

say:10:1223215007:1.text: Don't lose heart just yet. We need to believe in Al. He's been trying his best...
say:10:1223215007:1.source_cn: 别这样说，我们要相信阿尔，他是个有本事的……

say:11:1223215008:1.text: How long have things been like this? Not only have we not made a single dime, but we're losing money every day. If <style="stress"><player_name></style> wasn't here today, Paz would've died on the street like a sea slug!
say:11:1223215008:1.source_cn: 这都多久了？我们不仅没挣钱还天天赔钱，今天要不是有<s...
say:11:1223215008:1.male: How long have things been like this? Not only have we not made a single dime, but we're losing money every day. If <style="stress"><player_name></style> wasn't here today, Paz would've died on the street like a sea slug!
say:11:1223215008:1.female: How long have things been like this? Not only have we not made a single dime, but we're losing money every day. If <style="stress"><player_name></style> wasn't here today, Paz would've died on the street like a sea slug!

say:12:1223215009:1.text: I say we shouldn't have hoped for a fresh start in Rustport. Al's idea is a total flop!
say:12:1223215009:1.source_cn: 要我说，就不该幻想在锈锚港重新开始，都怪阿尔出的馊主意！

say:13:1223215010:1.text: See how exhausted everyone is. We work from dawn till dusk, only to get yelled and have our money taken away!
say:13:1223215010:1.source_cn: 你看看大家都被累成啥样了，每天早出晚归，出力被骂还赔钱！

say:16:1223215011:1.text: Alright, I know you're all upset. Why not just vent it all out now?
say:16:1223215011:1.source_cn: 行吧，知道你们不痛快，要不现在骂个爽？

say:17:1223215012:1.text: *Sigh* Life was so great back in the old days...
say:17:1223215012:1.source_cn: 唉，想想以前，咱们多痛快……

say:20:1223215013:1.text: Don't bring up the past if you want to stay alive.
say:20:1223215013:1.source_cn: 哥们，如果不想死，就别提以前了。

choice_prompt:21:1223215013.text: Don't bring up the past if you want to stay alive.
choice_prompt:21:1223215013.source_cn: 哥们，如果不想死，就别提以前了。

say:22:1223215014:1.text: We wouldn't dare. With you on the Carmine Whispers' side, we're no match for them.
say:22:1223215014:1.source_cn: 我们哪敢啊，血薇帮有了你这个帮手，我们只有被按在地上打的份。
say:22:1223215014:1.male: We wouldn't dare. With you on the Carmine Whispers' side, we're no match for them.
say:22:1223215014:1.female: We wouldn't dare. With you on the Carmine Whispers' side, we're no match for them.

say:26:1223215017:0.text: Actually, I've been wondering—since things are so tough in Rustport, why don't you just leave? You have boats, after all.
say:26:1223215017:0.source_cn: 其实我心里有个疑问，你们都有船，在锈锚港呆不下去的话，...

say:27:1223215018:1.text: Hammie's got a point. Since the port has reopened, you're free to leave whenever you want!
say:27:1223215018:1.source_cn: 对呀，港口也解锁了，你们想走随时都能走啊！

say:32:1223215020:1.text: Frankly speaking, we've got the skills to make it anywhere. However, this is where we grew up. If we leave, we'll become homeless wanderers.
say:32:1223215020:1.source_cn: 不怕你笑话，我们一身本领，到哪都能活。但这是我们长大的...

say:35:1223215021:1.text: We've tried leaving before, but the fish outside didn't suit our tastes, so we eventually came back.
say:35:1223215021:1.source_cn: 也不是没试过走，但兄弟们吃不惯外面的鱼，又回来了。

say:38:1223215022:1.text: Exactly! The fish out there just can't hold a candle to the ones we have here! By the way, I'm really craving some galefish right now!
say:38:1223215022:1.source_cn: 没错！外面的鱼根本没有锈锚港的肥，哈！说到这，我现在就...

say:41:1223215023:1.text: Hmph, the biggest galefish can only be caught during a storm. So just forget it, you noisy seagull...
say:41:1223215023:1.source_cn: 哼，最大的狂风鱼只有风暴天气才能抓到，你就算了！

say:42:1223215024:1.text: Are you looking down on me or something? How about we see who's better at fishing, sea slug?!
say:42:1223215024:1.source_cn: 嚯，敢嘲笑我？要不要来比比？

say:43:1223215025:0.text: I caught twenty last time. If I'm not mistaken, you only had fifteen, right?
say:43:1223215025:0.source_cn: 我上次的记录是二十条，你好像只有十五条吧？

say:44:1223215026:1.text: You rascal, it's only because I—

say:47:1223215027:1.text: Wait a minute. Since you guys are so good at catching fish...
say:47:1223215027:1.source_cn: 等等，你们既然这么擅长抓鱼……

choice_prompt:48:1223215027.text: Wait a minute. Since you guys are so good at catching fish...
choice_prompt:48:1223215027.source_cn: 等等，你们既然这么擅长抓鱼……

say:50:1223215028:0.text: That's right! Since you're having trouble finding a job, why don't you start your own business?
say:50:1223215028:0.source_cn: 对呀！你们既然找不到工作，干嘛不自己做生意？

say:51:1223215029:0.text: Hmm... selling fish? Yeah, that makes sense! We not only know how to catch them but also how to clean them.
say:51:1223215029:0.source_cn: 这……卖鱼？对啊，兄弟们不仅会抓还会处理鱼，很适合干这个！

say:54:1223215030:1.text: This... sounds like a good idea. Why didn't I think of it before...
say:54:1223215030:1.source_cn: 这……好像的确是个点子，我怎么没想到呢……

say:55:1223215031:1.text: That's it! From now on, we're going to sell fish!
say:55:1223215031:1.source_cn: 决定了！接下来，我们卖鱼！

say:56:1223215032:1.text: Way to go! Running your own business is definitely better than working for others!
say:56:1223215032:1.source_cn: 这就对了嘛，自己经营铺子，肯定比打工有出路！

choice:48:1:2.text: You can set up a fish stall.
choice:48:1:2.male: You can set up a fish stall.
choice:48:1:2.female: You can set up a fish stall.

choice:21:0:1.text: Don't return to your old ways.
choice:21:0:1.male: Don't return to your old ways.
choice:21:0:1.female: Don't return to your old ways.

say:58:1223215015:1.text: I—I'm just blowing off some steam...
say:58:1223215015:1.source_cn: 我、我只是发泄一下不痛快……
say:58:1223215015:1.male: I—I'm just blowing off some steam...
say:58:1223215015:1.female: I—I'm just blowing off some steam...

say:61:1223215016:0.text: They just want to take it out on me. Let them do it; I'm used to it.
say:61:1223215016:0.source_cn: 他们只是想骂我，让他们骂吧，习惯了。
say:61:1223215016:0.male: They just want to take it out on me. Let them do it; I'm used to it.
say:61:1223215016:0.female: They just want to take it out on me. Let them do it; I'm used to it.
